Insurance Coverage

Check your eligibility before booking

PM-JAY / Ayushman Bharat

EVLT and RFA may be covered for eligible beneficiaries at empanelled hospitals when medically necessary.

Private Health Insurance

Most Indian health policies cover varicose vein treatment when medically necessary.

CGHS / ESI Schemes

Government employees can access treatment at approved rates. Pre-authorisation may be required.

Corporate Group Insurance

Coverage depends on your policy and employer benefits.
